links.note: Design only; nothing has been run. A runner would live under experiments/EXP-KOR-*/ with its own specification.yaml; this record binds by hash in execution_plan.protocol_hashes.

question: Is the p-independent kernel height floor of specialisation over F_p(t) (about 4 in Shioda normalisation, the pole term 2 plus the 2*chi offset) a property of the attacker-relevant quantity, the shortest kernel vector of a prescribed fibre, or only of the minimum over fibres; and does the 'coverage excess' that EV-CZLIFT-376eee traced to the Z kernel floor vanish over F_p(t)?

claims.text: Over Z, the shortest kernel vector of red_p on the ladder curves satisfies lambda1 - 2 log p >= 0.91 on primes disjoint from the 16 used in EV-CZLIFT-376eee, and the in-sample cells recompute exactly (37a1, 389a1, 5077a1, 234446a1 included).

Over F_p(t), minimum over all good fibres of lambda1 equals the Shioda floor 4 on every surface of rank >= 4 whose lattice has a norm-4 vector (consequence of h = 2 + 2(s.O) - contr; a code-correctness check, not a finding).
Prescribed-fibre lambda1(t0) over F_p(t) is NOT p-independent: in rank strata r = 2 and 4 it grows like (index)^(2/r), i.e. the F_p(t) floor is a lower bound only, as in Z.
claims.if_supported: the lead's falsifier fires on the prescribed-fibre reading: F5 inherits the kernel-index scaling and the 'not inherited' line of KN-TECH-06bb4e needs rewording to 'floor not inherited, scaling inherited'
claims.if_not_supported: prescribed-fibre lambda1 is flat in p in the tested range; widen p before concluding anything

claims.text: The real specialisation map differs from its random-homomorphism control in coverage excess over Z (replication of 1.0338 vs 1.0142) but not over F_p(t) (the lead's 'excess absent' claim), measured as a difference in differences.
claims.if_supported: the coverage excess is ring-specific, as the lead says; floor-driven clumping is a Z phenomenon
claims.if_not_supported: excess also present over F_p(t) (or absent over Z): the ring-specific explanation is wrong

claims.text: Oracle lemma: an oracle returning a kernel vector of prescribed support with entries not both divisible by N recovers k in one call plus one modular inverse (N in {1009, 10007}, ranks 2, 3, 4, 6); box meet-in-the-middle for the same task costs a number of counted group operations proportional to sqrt(N) with no trend in r; the p-adic formal-logarithm channel recovers k on anomalous curves and fails on same-size non-anomalous curves.
Any statement about cryptographic sizes, any speedup, any ECDLP attack.

hypotheses.statement: Expected null for the lead's headline: the F_p(t) kernel floor is a constant (4) but the shortest kernel vector at a prescribed fibre grows with p like a Gaussian-heuristic sublattice minimum, so the lemma and 'closure instrument' standing of the lead survive while its sentence 'floor independent of p' must be restricted to the minimum over fibres.
hypotheses.mechanism: specialisation at t0 is a homomorphism from a fixed rank-r lattice to a group of order ~p; its kernel has index m ~ p, so lambda1 ~ m^(2/r) det(L)^(1/r) unless short vectors exist; for E8-like lattices with 1080 pairs of norm-4 vectors each meeting O at one rational t, the plateau at 4 persists until p ~ the number of such vectors.

predictions.minimum_effect: min over fibres of lambda1 equals 4 exactly on every surface with a norm-4 vector in L (C2)
stratum r=4: OLS slope of log(median lambda1(t0)) on log p over the 10 primes excludes 0 at 95% and is within 0.25 of 2/r = 0.5; stratum r=8 (if measurable): median stays 4 for p <= 97
F_p(t): median(real) - median(randhom control) within +-0.005 (Z reference value: 1.0338 - 1.0142 = +0.020)

data_seen.measured: Z values only; nothing over F_p(t)

provenance.decisive_scope: the F_p(t) cells; the Z reference is calibration

predictions.minimum_effect: Z, primes disjoint from the 16 used: every cell has lambda1 - 2 log p > 0.91 - 1e-9 or the minimum is reported with its curve

data_seen.measured: min lambda1 - 2 log p = 0.9129 over 86 cells of the 16 primes

provenance.decisive_scope: cells at primes outside the 16 used in EV-CZLIFT-376eee

hypotheses.statement: The lead's own reading: the F_p(t) floor is p-independent as the stated quantity, and kernel clumping is absent over F_p(t). H0 is the lead's disposition under test; H1 is the null-leaning alternative above.
hypotheses.mechanism: as stated in the lead: a section through O at t0 has a pole of x of fixed order at t0, whose cost is the degree 1 of the place rather than log p.

predictions.minimum_effect: prescribed-fibre lambda1 flat in p (slope of log median lambda1 on log p within +-0.1) in every rank stratum (this is the lead's falsifier read literally; the design expects it to FAIL for r=2,4)

arms.description: Z arm, real reduction red_p on the ladder curves (37a1, 389a1, 5077a1, 234446a1, 19047851a1, 5187563742a1, 382623908456a1), generators and height matrix from rt_e data / PARI ellheightmatrix, shortest kernel vector by Fincke-Pohst

parameters.primes: all good primes 101..3000 with E(F_p) cyclic, split into the 16 EV-CZLIFT primes (calibration) and the rest (decisive)

arms.description: F_p(t) arm, real specialisation at every good fibre t0 of y^2 = x^3 + b(t), deg b = 6, L = span of all F_p(t)-rational height-2 (polynomial) sections

Z arm recomputed with a unimodular change of generator basis, reversed prime order and a second enumerator (brute force over the LLL box); differs only in nuisance factors, so lambda1 must agree to 1e-9
Z arm, 200 random Z-linear homomorphisms L -> E(F_p) of the same image index per cell (rt_f recipe), same Fincke-Pohst code

F_p(t) arm, 200 random Z[omega]-equivariant homomorphisms L -> E_t0(F_p) of the same image index per cell (omega acts by (x,y) -> (omega x, y) on both sides), plus 200 plain Z-linear ones reported separately; equivariance is required because the real map commutes with omega and Z-linear random maps would confound ring with symmetry

Planted kernel vector through the same code path: F_p(t) surfaces built so a known section of height 4 meets O at a chosen t0, and Z cells (curve, p) with p | den x(nP) for n in 2..6; the minimiser must return lambda1 <= the planted height

parameters.planted: known section / known multiple with p in den x(nP)

arms.description: Toy group Z/N, N in {1009, 10007}, ranks 2,3,4,6, 1000 planted k per cell; oracle returns a prescribed-support kernel vector (random one and shortest one); degenerate oracle returning N*u as negative check; counted calls and modular inverses
Box meet-in-the-middle for the same task over the N^(1/r) box, counted group operations by kind; BSGS on the rank-2 instance is the matched reference

positive.expected_detection: all planted kernel vectors are found: returned lambda1 <= planted height in 100% of planted cells (Clopper-Pearson lower bound > 0.97 at 100 cells); plus the anomalous-curve control: Smart-style formal-log recovery of k on toy anomalous curves (#E = p) in O(1) scalar multiplications

null_population.description: random homomorphisms L -> fibre group with the same image index as the real map: Z-linear for Z cells, omega-equivariant for F_p(t) cells; and non-anomalous curves of the same p for the formal-log channel
null_population.generator: rt_f recipe (g uniform in (k Z/N)^r with gcd(g/k, N/k)=1) for Z; equivariant analogue on a Z[omega]-basis of L for F_p(t); seeds from the protocol hash
null_population.why_n: 200 per cell gives percentile resolution 0.005 per cell; the decisive tests pool over cells and use 9999 resamples

factors.name: lattice_rank_r
factors.how: stratum; every statistic is reported per r and compared only within a stratum

factors.name: image_index_m
factors.how: matched between real and random-hom control by construction; reported; lambda1 also normalised by m^(2/r) det(L)^(1/r)

factors.name: height_normalisation
factors.value: Z: PARI ellheight (lim log H(x(nP))/n^2); F_p(t): Shioda 2*chi + 2(s.O) - contr, which equals the same limit of naive x-height over n^2
factors.how: stated per ring; floors are 2 log p - c_E and 4

factors.name: surface_sample
factors.how: seed from protocol hash; first section (x,y) uniform then b = y^2 - x^3, independent of arm

factors.name: fibre_t0
factors.how: every good fibre t0 in P^1(F_p) of every kept surface

factors.name: omega_symmetry
factors.value: all F_p(t) surfaces have p = 1 mod 3 and L is a Z[omega]-module; null maps are equivariant

factors.name: generator_basis
factors.how: A/A arm re-draws a unimodular basis

factors.name: host
factors.how: recorded; no clock is a metric

comparisons.threshold: slope of log median lambda1(t0) on log p in stratum r=4 excludes 0 (95% bootstrap over surfaces) and lies in [0.25, 0.75]

seed_derivation.note: surface draws, null homomorphisms and planted k derive from the protocol hash via experiment_protocol.py seeds --all

instance_sampling.rule: F_p(t): per prime draw (x,y) uniform among polynomials deg x<=2, deg y<=3 with b=y^2-x^3 of degree exactly 6, squarefree, non-square, scan all p^3 quadratic x for further polynomial sections, keep rank >= 2 surfaces until 30 per prime or 3000 draws; Z: all good cyclic primes of the fixed curve list; toy: planted k uniform in [1,N-1] from the seed

blinding.how: deterministic exact computations; arm labels carry no steering risk beyond the predictions pre-registered here

power.note: N=9999 null resamples (50 random-hom draws pooled per cell, resampled over cells) give 2/(N+1)=2e-4 < alpha/m=0.05/6. This checks resolution only. Effect-size justification: the Z contrast to be reproduced is +0.020 (1.0338 vs 1.0142) with null band half-width 0.005; the F_p(t) contrast is declared absent only if the interval lies inside +-0.005 over >= 150 cells (EV-CZLIFT-376eee: 86 Z cells gave a band of +-0.005). Rank strata r=6,8 may be unmeasurable by density and are then reported as such.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: estimate, not measured: p^3 slot scan 9e5 x ~100 ops for p=97 is ~1 s per surface, Fincke-Pohst at r<=8 on <=100 fibres/surface negligible; no probe run

primary.name: lambda1
primary.unit: height units (PARI for Z, Shioda for F_p(t))
primary.definition: minimum canonical height over nonzero v in ker(red) of the lattice, by Fincke-Pohst on the Gram matrix; per cell (curve,p) or (surface,t0)

primary.name: lambda1 minus floor
primary.definition: lam1 - (2 log p) for Z; lam1 - 4 for F_p(t)

primary.name: coverage ratio
primary.definition: distinct residues of {s in L: h(s) <= B} divided by N(1-(1-1/N)^|S_B|) with N the fibre group order and B the least bound with |S_B| >= N/10

primary.name: oracle calls to recover k
primary.definition: kernel-vector oracle invocations before k is returned and verified by [k]P=Q

primary.name: box MITM cost
primary.unit: affine point additions (1 inv + 2 mul + 1 sqr) and doublings (1 inv + 2 mul + 2 sqr), plus table lookups counted separately
primary.definition: group operations of the half-box table build and the lookup pass until a prescribed-support kernel vector with both entries nonzero and not in N*Z^r is found; no canonicalisation exists in this setting (charged zero)

secondary.name: fraction of fibres with lambda1 = floor

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 300 F_p(t) surfaces (30 x 10 primes) or 3000 draws per prime, whichever first; all good Z primes in range; toy 1000 planted k per cell (oracle) and 200 (MITM); then stop
a stratum with fewer than 10 surfaces is reported unmeasurable by density and decides nothing

invalidation_rules: F_p(t) cell where Gram matrix rank differs between runner and checker is excluded and reported
any cell where the planted-control arm fails invalidates the 'nothing found' reading of that ring
Z cells with non-cyclic E(F_p) are skipped and counted, as in rt_f

decision_rule.text: C2 and C5 must hold exactly or the runner is wrong (no verdict on the lead). C3 is supported if the stratum r=4 slope interval excludes 0 and lies in [0.25, 0.75]; this FALSIFIES the lead's p-independence sentence on the prescribed-fibre reading (expected). C4 is supported if the Z contrast reproduces (+0.020, interval excluding 0) and the F_p(t) contrast lies in +-0.005; if F_p(t) also shows a contrast excluding 0, 'ring-specific' is falsified. Verdicts per claim; Holm over the 6 tests.
decision_rule.statistic: OLS slope of log median lambda1 on log p per stratum; difference in differences of median cov_ratio

graphs: lambda1 vs p per stratum with floor and Gaussian curves
cov_ratio real vs randhom per ring
toy MITM cost over sqrt(N) by r

inadmissible: reading the minimum over fibres (a consequence of h = 2 + 2(s.O)) as evidence that the prescribed-fibre quantity is p-independent
comparing Z-linear random maps with the omega-equivariant real F_p(t) map
changing the rank strata, prime lists, B rule or N/10 coverage rule after seeing data
dropping the Z calibration cells or counting in-sample primes towards decisive Z predictions
claiming any attack, speedup or exponent change from a lemma that is a closure instrument

Z floor D2 and its measured minimum 0.9129 at 234446a1 p=103; 37a1 and 389a1 minima are 92.8 and 2.94, so the floor does not bind on rank 1
